# Microck

> Microck builds tools and resources for AI agents and developers.

## Site languages

- [English](https://micr.dev/en/): English landing page.
- [Espanol](https://micr.dev/es/): Spanish landing page.

## Projects

- [Akron](https://akron.micr.dev/): Celeste mod downloads and documentation.
- [kagi CLI](https://kagi.micr.dev/): Command-line interface and MCP server documentation for Kagi.
- [Moji](https://moji.micr.dev/): Font discovery and download CLI documentation.

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Microck): Source code and projects.
- [X](https://x.com/JustMicrock): Updates from Microck.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Microck): Videos from Microck.
